name: Anti-Fiancé
source:
"What are you hiding from me?" You're faced with two choices as you act as a fake fiancée in your twin sister's place. Will you choose your arrogant and outspoken fiancé Hayden, or fool him with the help of the person who knows your secret: your reliable assistant and longtime fan, Fynn! Whose hand will you take to find true happiness?

[From in-app]
